basic.name: Basic
basic.copy: A focused collection of visual cards for building water confidence, aquatic skills and technique.
inside: 43 activity flashcards, plus index and instruction cards
basic.audience: For families and individual swimming professionals introducing and practising aquatic skills.

fun.name: Fun
fun.copy: Pictures, toys and shared activities. Make the game easier to see, understand and join.
inside: Swimming toys including ducks, bucket, ball, pop tube, water pistol and sinkers
fun.audience: For families and swimming professionals who want to bring visual support into playful pool sessions.

full.name: Full
full.copy: The complete physical collection for planning varied swimming sessions across skills, routines and play.
inside: Four teaching folders and a session-plan folder
First, Next, Then stands and a card holder
Swimming toys, bags, towel and marker
full.audience: For swimming schools, centres and coaches building a shared collection of physical teaching materials. This is a physical product; organisation software is a separate future offering.
